title: Host Damage Protection (HostCover) Plan Terms: Eligibility, Activation, Plan Year and Lapse
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** plan terms by level: which listings may hold a level, when cover begins, which stays it covers, how level changes apply, how the plan year runs, when the plan lapses, where it applies, where reimbursements go and whether Roamhaven recovers from the guest.

## Terms that differ by level

| HostCover level | Waiting period after enrollment (calendar days) | Eligible listing space types |
|---|---|---|
| HostCover Essential | 0 | Shared Room, Private Room, Entire Guest Suite, Entire Apartment, Entire Home, Luxury Villa |
| HostCover Standard | 3 | Shared Room, Private Room, Entire Guest Suite, Entire Apartment, Entire Home, Luxury Villa |
| HostCover Plus | 3 | Shared Room, Private Room, Entire Guest Suite, Entire Apartment, Entire Home, Luxury Villa |
| HostCover Premier | 3 | Entire Guest Suite, Entire Apartment, Entire Home, Luxury Villa |
| HostCover Elite | 3 | Entire Apartment, Entire Home, Luxury Villa |
| HostCover Estate | 3 | Luxury Villa |

## Terms common to every level

| Term | Every level |
|---|---|
| Stays covered | stays checking in on or after the effective date while the plan is active |
| Stays a level change affects | stays checking in after the change date |
| Days that must pass between two level changes on one plan | 90 calendar days |
| Plan year | 12 months from the effective date, renewing on each anniversary |
| Plan lapses when its listing is removed | Yes |
| Plan lapses when the host account is deactivated | Yes |
| Where the plan applies | listings in the United States |
| Where reimbursements are paid | credited to the host account's default payout method |
| Roamhaven recovers paid reimbursements from the responsible guest | Yes |

## Reading the terms

- The waiting period is counted in calendar days after enrollment: 0 on HostCover Essential, so cover is effective on the enrollment date, and 3 on every paid level.
- A Private Room listing may hold HostCover Essential, Standard or Plus, but not Premier, Elite or Estate; a Luxury Villa may hold any of the six levels.
- Hypothetical illustration: a plan whose effective date is 10 March has a plan year running to 9 March of the following year, and a new plan year from that anniversary.
